title: Count the Objects (static)
statementMd:
A `static` field belongs to the **class**, so every object shares one copy — perfect for counting how many objects exist. An instance field belongs to each **object**.

Give each new `Student` the next id number, and keep the shared total up to date. `main` is written.

**Input**
One integer `n` — how many students to create.

**Output**
Each student’s id on its own line, then `Total students: n`.
hints: The constructor runs once per object: increase the shared count there.
count++ then this.id = count; gives the first student id 1. A static field keeps its value between objects.
